## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from T&F publisher pages and domain knowledge of personality assessment editorial culture (SPA — Society for Personality Assessment). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — cross-cultural assessment validation important |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Personality assessment — MMPI, PAI, Rorschach, projective assessment, self-report assessment, multitrait-multimethod, classical test theory + IRT validation |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **personality assessment contribution** — measurement development, validation, cross-cultural assessment, clinical assessment, psychometric methodology.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts without assessment focus redirected.

| Autoethnography | 0 | Outside scope |
| Theoretical / Conceptual | 3 | With empirical validation |
| Mixed methods | 2 | Outside dominant scope |
| Meta-analysis | 5 | Welcomed for assessment validation synthesis |
| Psychometric / IRT / SEM | 5 | Distinctive strength |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without assessment / measurement focus
- AI use without disclosure per T&F policy
- Insufficient psychometric rigor

### Soft Tax

Low for psychometric / assessment tradition authors.

### Best Suited For

- Personality test development and validation
- Cross-cultural assessment studies
- Projective assessment research (Rorschach, TAT)
- Clinical personality assessment
- IRT and factor structure studies
- Multi-trait multi-method validation
- Assessment meta-analyses

### Not Recommended For

- Pure personality theory without assessment
- Pure social psychology
- Pure qualitative work

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Personality](./journal-of-personality.md) | Wiley peer; broader personality focus |
| 2 | [Personality and Individual Differences](./personality-and-individual-differences.md) | Elsevier peer; individual differences scope |
| 3 | [Assessment](../psychology/assessment.md) | SAGE peer for clinical assessment |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a broader personality venue as "too measurement-focused," JPA is the SPA-affiliated home for assessment research.
